generated.description: A wide, low snow-and-ice terrain piece about 46 wide, 14 high and 60 deep, made mostly of dirt, stone, snow blocks and ice, with grass patches, oak and spruce trees, a small water pool, sugar cane, and a few spruce plank and slab accents. It also contains a single furnace, and the source gives no description of its purpose, so it reads as a scenic winter landscape rather than a finished building. Roughly 17,500 blocks in total.
